description: Read web and supported social-platform links through a locally installed DigCrawl MCP server, or analyze an explicitly requested local video path or direct-media URL through its CLI. Use when a user asks to read, analyze, quote, compare, OCR, transcribe, or summarize a provided URL; or explicitly opts a supported platform into local image or video saving. Especially supports WeChat articles, Xiaohongshu notes, Douyin or Toutiao videos, X posts, Reddit, RSS/Atom feeds, and supported Chinese social platforms. Use the host Agent to read returned image attachments and to summarize retrieved content; use local ASR only for an explicit video-transcription request. Preserve structured errors for unavailable, login-gated, captcha-gated, or rate-limited content.
